checks.title: Headline resolution against native resolution
checks.summary: The headline names 4K (8,294,400 pixels) and the listing gives a native resolution of 1,280 × 720 (921,600 pixels). The headline figure is 9× the native pixel count. A projector can accept an input signal at a higher resolution than it displays, so this is reported as a flag rather than a hard result.
checks.formula: ratio = headline pixels ÷ native pixels, where pixels = width × height

steps.label: Pixels in the headline resolution

steps.label: Pixels in the native resolution
steps.text: Pixels in the native resolution: 1,280 × 720 = 921,600 pixels

steps.label: Headline pixels divided by native pixels
steps.text: Headline pixels divided by native pixels: 8,294,400 ÷ 921,600 = 9 (> 1)
